components.explanation: canvas_item shader on the HUD ammo label, driven by a presentation-only node from the player's ammo_changed signal; the shader's line 12 skips the black theme shadow (revision).
Headless SceneTree test: uniform list and source defaults, R1-R9 with real input at a pinned frame rate; R7 uses a test-emitted signal.
One 3x1 grey PNG read through a source_color sampler and a plain one on two unshaded quads; measured against the brief's prediction.
Lit spatial shader with one colour and two data textures (Poly Haven CC0), two ShaderMaterials (dry, wet) from it, a lab scene to judge them, and level.gd putting them on the floors.
Godot 4.7.2's generated StandardMaterial3D shader, saved by a RID-scan tool, compared line for line with concrete_surface.
Material test (hints from source, values, import settings, formats, normal-map convention) and the calibrated kit normal-map check with its DX fixture.
Windowed 4K SubViewport capture and pixel measurement for the controlled values, hint experiment, sweep and two-material comparison.
